name: Hexahedral Mesh Traversal (Bilinear Patch-Extension)
definition: A hybrid traversal method combining Plücker tests for face selection and bilinear patch tests for intersection to avoid singularities and discontinuities.
summary: This hybrid algorithm uses bilinear patch intersections to determine exit faces and parametric coordinates, avoiding the discontinuities of triangle-based interpolation found in pure Plücker traversal.
